data.action: 左手压住长凳上备用制服的袖口，右手把软尺拉到肩缝，低头鼓腮检查袖长。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, closed sports outfit and measuring hands on the bench visible
data.description: 体育课后，娜娜穿扣好的藏蓝运动外套和长运动裤，坐在更衣室木长凳旁检查备用水手服的袖长。白衬衫平摊在长凳上，她左手压住袖口，右手把软尺拉到肩缝，看到偏大的尺寸便鼓起两腮。粉色双马尾在肩后摆动，黑色心形尾巴轻拍凳脚——「哼！明明选了正确尺码，袖子怎么还是这么长！我可不想上课时一直卷袖子！」半开的铁柜、挂好的毛巾与地面运动包形成背景，顶灯照尺面与白布，凳下留柔影。
data.lighting: warm ceiling light on the laid-out white sleeve and tape; soft shade beneath the bench
data.location: 女生体育更衣室木长凳旁，半开铁柜与挂毛巾在后方
data.mood: 尺码偏大后的气鼓鼓喜剧
data.promptProse: Seated beside the bench in her fully zipped sports jacket, Nana pins the spare blouse laid flat on the bench at its cuff with her left hand, stretching the tape to its shoulder seam with her right. Warm ceiling light reaches the measuring marks, with soft shade beneath the bench, as she pouts.
data.title: 娜娜 · 更衣室里偏长的制服袖口
data.identityProseOverride: Nana Asta Deviluke from To LOVE-Ru, with long pink twintails, purple-pink eyes and a black spade-heart tail.
data.animaCaption: Her left hand pins the blouse cuff to the bench while her right stretches the tape to its shoulder seam.
